in_arabic.name: Sadit
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Lady of the Garden
in_arabic.long_meaning: Sadit هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. The one who is the lady of the garden, a beautiful and graceful woman who embodies joy, happiness, and love.

in_urdu.name: Sadit
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Lady of the Garden
in_urdu.long_meaning: Sadit ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ The one who is the lady of the garden, a beautiful and graceful woman who embodies joy, happiness, and love.

in_hindi.name: Sadit
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lady of the Garden
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sadit एक इस्लामी नाम है जो मुस्लिम संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The one who is the lady of the garden, a beautiful and graceful woman who embodies joy, happiness, and love.

in_pashto.name: Sadit
in_pashto.meaning: اسلامي نوم چې معنی یې ده Lady of the Garden
in_pashto.long_meaning: Sadit یو اسلامي نوم دی چې په مسلم کلتور کې ژوره روحاني اهميت لري. The one who is the lady of the garden, a beautiful and graceful woman who embodies joy, happiness, and love.
